en.title: Support at every step
en.text: Dear Kristina, you are everything a person needs in a trainer. From a personalized training and nutrition plan fully adapted to my goals and capabilities, time and equipment available at that moment, to education — explaining why I am doing something, not just what and how. What I like most is that I have your support at every moment and that you always check whether everything is all right, correct my form in the videos I send you, give me guidance and push me toward further progress. Online mentorship works so well that I really feel like you are with me in the gym at every workout. Thank you for focusing on long-term habits, as I wanted, rather than only short-term goals focused on appearance. From the heart.

sr.title: Podrška na svakom koraku
sr.text: Draga Kristina, ti si sve što osoba treba od jednog trenera. Od personaliziranog plana treninga i prehrane koji je u potpunosti prilagođen mojim ciljevima i mogućnostima, vremenu i opremi koju imam u određenom trenutku, do edukacije - objašnjenja zašto nešto radim, a ne samo što i kako. Najviše mi se sviđa što u svakom trenutku imam tvoju podršku i što uvijek provjeravaš je li sve u redu, ispravljaš formu na snimcima koje ti šaljem, daješ mi smjernice za dalje i guraš me u daljnji napredak. Online mentorstvo funkcionira tako dobro da stvarno imam osjećaj da si svaki moj trening samnom u teretani. Hvala ti što stavljaš fokus na dugoročne navike, kako sam i htjela, a ne samo na neke kratkoročne ciljeve kojima je fokus samo izgled. Od srca.

en.title: Clear, helpful guidance
en.text: I have to tell you, I am thrilled! Well done! Everything is explained so well, just wow — I am so glad I found you! The videos work, no worries.

sr.title: Jasne i korisne smernice
sr.text: Moram da ti kazem da sam odusevljena! Svaka cast! Sve je takooo dobrooo objasnjeno znaci wau wauu bas mi drago da te pronasla! Snimci rade, bez brige.

en.title: Feeling stronger
en.text: As for the results, I notice them, and so do the people around me. My legs and glutes have visibly toned up, and my glutes have grown a little. My strength has really increased and I am very happy about that. My upper body was always weak, but now I notice how much stronger my arms are and my back is starting to become defined. I have a little excess weight and plan to lose it with a deficit, but I did not want to dwell on that because it is not as important to me — I wanted to work more on my form and strength.

sr.title: Više snage
sr.text: Ej, sto se tice rezultata ja ih primetim, a i ljudi oko mene. Noge i glut su mi se bas vidno zategli, a glut malo i povecao. Snaga mi je bas porasla i time sam jako zadovoljna. Gornji deo mi je uvek bio slab i mlitav da tako kazem, a sad primetim koliko su mi ruke ojacale i ledja pocela da se definisu. Msm ja imam mali visak kilograma i planiram da ga skinem deficitom, al nisam htela time da se opterecujem jer mi to nije vazno toliko, vise sam htela da radim na formi i snazi.

en.title: Technique that makes a difference
en.text: Share a personal success: I finally realized I was positioning my lifting straps incorrectly, and in my very first workout with them properly tightened I achieved a personal record of 80 kg for 6 reps on the Romanian deadlift. I could not believe it, so thank you so much for the advice. I can also do five push-ups without any assistance.

sr.title: Tehnika koja pravi razliku
sr.text: 5. Podeli neki lični uspeh. E ovakooo, prvo konacno sam skontala da sam pogresno namestala gurtne i vec na prvom treningu sa pravilno zategnutim gurtnama postigla sam PR 80kgx6 rumunskog mrtvog. Bila sam u neverici, tako da hvala ti puno na savetu. Takodje mogu da uradim pet sklekova bez bilo kakve asistencije.
